services.name: Papaw Pontoon
services.desc: Our new 22′ pontoon called Papaw (which means Grandpa in our Southern States) (holds up to 11 guests + captain capacity). Papaw is the same capacity size pontoon boat as Grandpa, so click on Book Now to learn about availability and pricing. Papaw is not a boat for the novice, part time boater. If you have marginal skill or no documented skill, we recommend you hire a captain, or we will suggest you renting Meemaw or Granny Pontoon instead. The captain must be considered as one of the 12 in the capacity. Papaw is Grandpa’s brother and we feel will also be a huge fan favorite. So, Book Now early and often. Papaw is perfect for Corporate Outings either small groups or apart of our Floatzilla
